name: rule-guard
description: Rule Guard: stops tool calls that break your standing rules (no AI credit in commits, plain version tags, ask before push or release, no killing by name, no skipped git hooks, stop at the pass limit) and tells Claude what to do instead.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn off and Rule Guard stops nothing: every tool call goes through, whatever the rules below say.

noAttribution.title: No AI credit in commits
noAttribution.description: Stop a commit, pull request or release that credits Claude or AI (Co-Authored-By, Generated with, and the like). On by default.

plainTags.title: Plain version tags
plainTags.description: Stop version tags that start with v, such as v1.2.3. Plain tags like 1.2.3 pass. On by default.

askBeforePublish.title: Ask before push or release
askBeforePublish.description: Stop a push, new tag, release, publish or merge unless your latest message asks for it (push, publish, release, tag, ship, deploy or merge). On by default.

noKillByName.title: No killing by name
noKillByName.description: Stop commands that end processes by name (Stop-Process -Name, taskkill /IM, pkill, killall). Processes should be stopped by their ID. On by default.

noSkipHooks.title: Never skip git hooks
noSkipHooks.description: Stop git commands that skip hooks or signing (--no-verify, --no-gpg-sign, commit.gpgsign=false). On by default.

passCap.title: Stop at the pass limit
passCap.description: Stop a new test or build run once the Context mod says the pass limit is reached and files changed since the last pass. On by default.

publishWords.title: Words that allow a push or release
publishWords.description: Words in your latest message that let a push, tag, release or merge through, separated by commas. Default (empty): push, publish, release, tag, ship, deploy, merge.

showToast.title: Show a message when it stops something
showToast.description: Show a short "Rule Guard stopped" message each time a call is stopped. Claude is told either way. On by default.

keepStops.title: Stops to remember
keepStops.description: How many recent stops are kept for the Sidebar, from 1 to 100; the default is 10.
